change_summary: Normal MCP tool results carry live server identity and explicit client freshness in text and structured content. Stable notices distinguish unknown/current/compatible/unsupported, source-owned update and Host-reported acknowledgment. Content-free per-binding observations reuse identical states for 24 hours; new sessions verify loaded guidance. Candidate only; publication and customer UI acceptance remain separate. Living Memory is a disabled-server candidate: selected consented Work Deltas, task Context and operation receipts share one packet owner; no Plugin release is authorized.

canonical_skill.note: First-use consumes normal result facts or one exact-fact check. Current is quiet; unknown interrupts only material work; install and new-session loading remain distinct. Enabled-catalog work context/capture with authority, temporal and source boundaries; native trigger is separately installed and consented.

server_contract.note: Normal text/structured facts, optional namespaced reports and notice acknowledgment; explicit unsupported facts fail closed before business execution. Current/compatible/unknown retain OAuth, scopes and business owners; default-full unchanged. Optional record_work/get_work_operation/get_context/expand_context preserve existing search/read; feature disabled by default.

package_manifests.note: Candidate version 1.7.103/contract 2026-10-25.1. Compatibility minimum/family unchanged; protected immutable release and remote version/hash readback remain pending.

workspace_cli.note: No CLI source/version change. Shared family and minimum revision remain; this candidate changes MCP/Skill instruction and response projections only.
